human_actions_pending.context: Optional but recommended for production VAD accuracy. Not required for development/testing due to fallback VAD.

decisions.decision: Make webrtcvad optional with fallback energy-based VAD
decisions.rationale: webrtcvad-wheels requires VC++ Build Tools (~6GB) on Windows. Fallback allows immediate development without this barrier.
Enables mocking without importing webrtcvad, supports future VAD backends (Silero)
Minimize dev dependencies. Manual QApplication fixture is sufficient.
Avoid bundled PNG assets in git. Icon draws at runtime.

decisions.decision: Model assets not in git; registry stores expected paths
decisions.rationale: Model binaries are large. Registry provides checksums and side-load guidance without network download.
